$comment: Archived FID ids the changelog-coverage gate cannot see, even with full notation parsing. The gate fails on any id NOT listed here. Keep it EMPTY: an entry is only correct when the id genuinely has no release note, and it must be removed the moment one is written — that is the ratchet.
$measured: 2026-09-27 by scripts/changelog-coverage.ts against all 419 archived FID records: zero gaps, so this list is empty. It once held 14 ids. They were retired for three distinct reasons, and the distinction matters when a gap reappears — an id can be invisible because its work is documented under ANOTHER record, or because no record exists yet, and only the second is real debt. (1) FID-2026-0901-003: its six deck ambient-life features were documented in the 2026-09-02 release-ready-audit section but credited to FID-2026-0831-001/-002, which also claimed a floor-suite gate (178/0) that only 0901-003 ever reported. (2) FID-2026-0809-013 and -015..-018: hidden behind a full-id range heading, uncovered only because an early parser broke on the word 'through'. (3) FID-2026-0809-003..007, -009, -010 and FID-2026-0805-003: named in the v0.0.23 section by SHORT FORM ('FIDs 003-010'), which the gate could not resolve because that section carried its 2026-0809 wave only inside a lowercase Nova inbox path. The gate now resolves short forms against their own section's full ids and heading date, which is what emptied this list.
